description: Erection of an extension to exisiting single storey garage at rear of property.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (010; 031; 122; 132; D 01; D 04  Received:  22 June 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the extended single storey rear outbuilding hereby approved.

Condition : 5 - The extended rear outbuilding hereby approved shall be used only for purposes incidental to the residential use of the single household host dwelling, shall not include kitchen, bathroom or bedroom facilities, a registered company office or be converted into a self-contained dwelling, and shall be permanently retained as such.
